name: Vadinar
source: Nayara Energy Vadinar terminal (20 MMTPA refinery intake) plus Reliance Sikka/Jamnagar SPM complex; ~1.4 mb/d combined crude discharge. EIA/PPAC terminal data 2025-26

name: Mundra
source: APSEZ SBM 9 MMTPA + sanctioned 10 MMTPA expansion feeding the 17.5 MMTPA Mundra-Panipat crude pipeline (IOCL Board, Dec 2021) + HMEL dedicated SBM ~11.3 MMTPA for Bathinda. ~0.9 mb/d built-out. NOTE: model routes 1.155 mb/d here - excess reflects the notional 3-corridor->port split; inland cluster refineries (Panipat, Mathura) also draw crude from Vadinar via the Salaya-Mathura pipeline in reality

name: Sikka
source: Sikka marine terminal, Gujarat - part of the Jamnagar SPM complex; modelled as IOC Koyali alternate receiving point

name: Mumbai JNPT
source: BPCL Uran + HPCL Mumbai offshore moorings; combined Mumbai refinery intake 21.5 MMTPA (~0.43 mb/d). NOTE: model routes 0.60 mb/d here - excess is notional corridor->port allocation, not physical capacity

name: Mangaluru
source: MRPL VLCC SPM at New Mangalore Port; refinery intake 15 MMTPA (~0.30 mb/d)

name: Kochi
source: BPCL Kochi SPM; refinery intake 15.5 MMTPA (~0.31 mb/d)

name: Chennai
source: CPCL Manali crude via Chennai/Kamarajar (Ennore) port; refinery intake 10.5 MMTPA (~0.21 mb/d). NOTE: model routes 0.483 mb/d here - excess is notional corridor->port allocation

name: Paradip
source: IOCL Paradip 3x VLCC SPM (~25 km offshore) + 1.1 MMT tank farm; feeds Paradip refinery (15 MMTPA) plus onward flow to Haldia/Barauni via PHBPL pipeline

name: Vizag
source: HPCL Visakhapatnam VLCC SPM; refinery intake 15 MMTPA (~0.30 mb/d) plus ISPR strategic petroleum reserve fills (1.33 MMT cavern at Visakhapatnam)

name: Haldia
source: IOCL Haldia dock (draft-limited on the Hooghly, no SPM); IOC Haldia refinery 8 MMTPA plus pipeline redistribution to Barauni and the NE refineries, also fed onward by PHBPL from Paradip
